# Run this schedule with RINGOUT_ROLLBACK_HORIZON_FRAMES=1. Drop a full

# impaired; the sender's persistent oldest-unacknowledged repair then delivers
# the first missing batch and lets the frozen peer resume. Starting at ordinal
# one avoids depending on how far one localhost process runs ahead during boot.
